intent: PSI-070: Migration M7 activity log — trigger-fed public.activity_log read model for agents, digests, and audit tracking.
summary: Implemented supabase/migrations/20260926050000_m7_activity_log.sql with public.activity_log table, RLS policy enforcing entity visibility (actor, board, role, group, event), triggers on tasks (inserts, updates, moves, deletes with position-only suppression), triggers on messages (sent/failed status), triggers on events (app-only source, Google imports skipped), and 180-day retention cron schedule. Added supabase/tests/activity_log.test.sql (9 pgTAP assertions).

changes.note: pgTAP suite for activity triggers and RLS

decisions.decision: Suppress task reordering within a column by checking business columns
decisions.reason: Kanban drag-and-drop fires frequent position-only updates that would flood the log with noise.

decisions.decision: Exclude external Google calendar events (source = 'google') from activity logging
decisions.reason: External imports arrive in bulk during sync; skipping prevents noise and avoids sync cycles.

decisions.decision: Do not expose an INSERT policy on activity_log to authenticated users
decisions.reason: Activity log is an immutable trigger-fed audit trail; clients must not fabricate log entries.

verification.manual: Verified database migration and 9 pgTAP assertions for activity triggers, reorder suppression, Google exclusion, and RLS.

human_review.reason: Awaiting human operator review stamp on PSI-070 card.
